4125-5232-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4125-5232-8043.description:
Cast Clone Legion for free due to Vision, creating a token copy of each creature you control.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Shipwreck Dowser token enters, it triggers, returning Clone Legion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1445-2034-4871-6277.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2034-4871-6277.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3558-3899-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crookshank Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
3558-3899-5006-8170.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crookshank Kobolds spell. Then, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat.

4875-5413-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4875-5413-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Trenching Steed ability, giving Trenching Steed +0/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

1981-2415-2842-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Blood Artist and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-6458-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
1981-2415-6458-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1619-4050-4605-5542-6151.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4050-4605-5542-6151.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Underdark Explorer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Underdark Explorer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Underdark Explorer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Underdark Explorer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Underdark Explorer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Underdark Explorer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4050-4605-5542-6151.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

2557-4871-6705.description:
Activate Quina by paying {2} and sacrificing a Frog.
When the Frog dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens and two 1/1 Frog creature tokens due to Quina and Parallel Lives.
Resolve the Quina ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

2609-2757-7496.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least three creatures.
You control a basic Plains.
2609-2757-7496.description:
Activate a basic Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {W} due to its affinity for creatures, creating a creature token and returning Recruit the Worthy to your hand.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping the basic Plains.
Repeat.

2577-6798-7390.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, The Ghoul triggers, causing you to get two rad counters and create a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

2440-4742-6737-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Barret's triggers, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token.
When the Rebel enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Rebel you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Rebel token.
Activate the Rebel by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-4742-6737-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Rebel.

57-2751-4068-4846.notablePrerequisites:
You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
You control at least one Mountain.
57-2751-4068-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4871-5295-7072.description:
Activate Joo Dee by paying {B} and tapping it, causing you to surveil 1 and then create a token copy of Joo Dee and sacrifice the tapped Joo Dee.
When the tapped Joo Dee dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat using the Joo Dee token.

944-1946-7070.description:
Activate Nomads en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Nomads en-Kor.
The Nomads en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Nomads en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Planar Gate.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1414-6791.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

645-1267-2511-6913.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-2511-6913.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Chameleon from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Chameleon.
Chameleon triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Chameleon
Repeat each turn.

2577-4871-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional Zombie.
You control another Zombie.
2577-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
2577-4871-6798.notes: Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you may repeat this loop spending mana from Treasures instead of the creature tokens, giving you infinite creature tokens.

2034-3240-4871-6560.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Nether Traitor, adding {C}{C}.
When Nether Traitor dies, Anafenza and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token and a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {C}{C}.
When the Spirit dies, Nether Traitor and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Nether Traitor trigger, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

325-5436-5796-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-5436-5796-6282.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
325-5436-5796-6282.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Witch-king of Angmar ability.
Repeat.

1020-1594-2866-6518.description:
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying {0}.
When Scrap Trawler enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Scrap Trawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {0}.
When Myr Retriever enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Myr Retriever and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

4772-4807-4871-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar's first ability by sacrificing Falkenrath Forebear, 
When Falkenrath Forebear dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating two Blood tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Falkenrath Forebear by paying {B} and sacrificing the two Bloods, returning Falkenrath Forebear from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2232-5659.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one nontoken nonartifact Lhurgoyf.
You have at least one nonartifact Lhurgoyf creature card in hand.
392-2232-5659.description:
Activate Harnfel by discarding a nonartifact Lhurgoyf card.
Disa the Restless' first ability triggers, putting the discarded Lhurgoyf from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When the Lhurgoyf enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning another nontoken nonartifact Lhurgoyf from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Harnfel ability from step 1, causing you to exile the top two cards of your library with the ability to play them until end of turn.
Repeat.

232-586-5626.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
232-586-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Priest of Urabrask and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Priest of Gix and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Urabrask from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1818-4186-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
1818-4186-4279.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Healer of the Pride trigger, causing you to gain 2 life
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride and Scurry Oak's evolve ability trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

948-2060-2433-2486-3129.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander on the battlefield.
You have at least one +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
948-2060-2433-2486-3129.description:
Activate Ooze Flux by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Ooze creature tokens, which will enter the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters each due to Primal Vigor and Master Chef.
Rosie Cotton of South Lane triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler and any creature you control due to Primal Vigor.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

224-2366-2532-5231.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
224-2366-2532-5231.description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
The Dryad Arbor token enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, untapping Jaxis.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Dryad Arbor token, adding {R}.
The Dryad Arbor token dies, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2581-5065.description:
Activate Helm of Obedience by paying {1} and tapping it, causing target opponent to mill a card.
Due to Dauthi Voidwalker's replacement effect, the milled card is exiled instead of going to the graveyard, and that opponents repeats that process until their library is empty.

915-1636-2034-3092.notablePrerequisites:
Synod Artificer does not have summoning sickness.
Orochi Hatchery has at least four charge counters on it.
915-1636-2034-3092.description:
Activate Orochi Hatchery by paying {5} and tapping it, creating at least four 1/1 Snake creature tokens.
Each Snake enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm that many times, untapping all creatures.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three Snakes, adding six {C}.
Activate Synod Artificer's second ability by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Orochi Hatchery.
Repeat.
